name: Bitcoin Embedding Protocols: A Technical Guide
headline: Bitcoin Embedding Protocols: Runes, Ordinals, BRC-20, Stamps, Omni, Counterparty
description: Technical comparison of data embedding protocols on Bitcoin. Covers OP_RETURN-based protocols (Runes, Omni, Counterparty), witness-based protocols (Ordinals, BRC-20), and bare multisig encoding (Stamps). Includes chronological timeline, pruning characteristics, and trade-offs.
